sources.currentTextNote: Checked on 2026-10-11 against the Publications Office repository, the document store behind EUR-Lex. No act has amended Regulation (EU) 2022/2554. Nine corrigenda exist, R(01) to R(09), dated 4.5.2023 to 21.11.2025, none for the English language version. The only consolidated version is 02022R2554-20221227, in twelve languages without English. A second download of the English Official Journal text on the same day reproduced the snapshot hash. The EUR-Lex website answered automated requests with a browser check, so its own display of consolidated versions and corrigenda was not read.
applicabilityAssumptions: The customer is a credit institution and therefore a financial entity (Article 2(1)(a) and Article 2(2)). Stipulated, not assessed.
The ICT service supports a critical or important function as defined in Article 3, point (22), so Article 30(3) applies in addition to Article 30(2). Stipulated, not assessed.
The customer is stipulated not to be a microenterprise within Article 3, point (60), so the derogation in Article 30(3), second subparagraph, which relates to point (e), does not apply.
Regulation (EU) 2022/2554 has applied since 17 January 2025 (Article 64, second paragraph).
notCovered: The other elements of Article 30: paragraph 1, paragraph 2 points (a), (c), (e), (g), (h) and (i), paragraph 3 points (b), (c) and (d), and paragraph 4.
Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2025/532 of 24 March 2025 on subcontracting, adopted on the basis of Article 30(5), OJ L, 2025/532, 2.7.2025, in force since 22 July 2025.

Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2024/1773 of 13 March 2024 on the policy on contractual arrangements, adopted on the basis of Article 28(10), OJ L, 2024/1773, 25.6.2024, in force since 15 July 2024.
Article 28(3), (7) and (8) of Regulation (EU) 2022/2554: the register of information, the circumstances in which the contract must be terminable, and exit plans.
National law and supervisory guidance, including BaFin circulars. The equally authentic German language version of the Regulation was not used.
